name: breadth-expansion
description: Where to grow by breadth: new cities, new venues, new market categories. The market is efficient; smarter/bigger/faster model angles are already ruled out.

points.name: Data availability
points.description: Is there an NWP-grade public/legal predictive data source for the underlying?

points.name: Forecast tractability
points.description: Does an EMOS-style calibrated distribution apply to the underlying?

points.name: Market efficiency & liquidity
points.description: Kalshi depth caps out ~500-700 contracts/city here — is the candidate thin, or actually mispriced?

points.name: Fee structure
points.description: ForecastEx is roughly half the Kalshi fee; maker vs taker economics decide viability of thin edges.

points.name: Edge durability
points.description: Would the edge persist, based on our own paper/live evidence?

points.name: Regulatory / geoblock
points.description: US-person access status. Geoblocks are never circumvented.
